OptoLAB welcomes motivated students and researchers interested in optical measurement, biomedical instrumentation, embedded systems and computational imaging. We regularly host bachelor's and master's thesis projects, and occasionally internships and PhD collaborations, connected to the laboratory's ongoing research directions.

## What we offer

- Hands-on work across the full measurement chain: optics, electronics, embedded acquisition and data analysis.
- Access to the laboratory's optical, imaging and embedded-computing equipment (see [Research → Facilities & capabilities](research.qmd#facilities-capabilities)).
- Supervision from a team with an active publication record in instrumentation, biomedical optics and sensing.
- The possibility of contributing to open, publishable research outputs.

## How to apply

1. Look through our [Research](research.qmd) areas to see what the lab currently works on.
2. Email Prof. Luigi Rovati with a short note on your background and the area you're interested in.
3. We'll get back to you to discuss available topics and next steps.
